title: OVIAH logo construction: grid and circle-overlap diagrams beside the final droplet mark and wordmark lockup

whatItMeans: Rigorous and intentional; showing the geometric construction proves the mark wasn't drawn freehand.

Show the mark both standalone and inside the wordmark.
Let the mark double as the first letter of the name.
